description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is hiring early-career Software Developers for product engineering teams across back-end, front-end, and full-stack areas. The role contributes to designing, building, testing, and maintaining cloud-ready software for AI-enabled and hybrid cloud solutions, in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Entry-Level Software Developer building and testing software components, backend services, APIs, data workflows, and React interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software components
• Build back-end services, APIs, or data workflows using languages such as Python, Java, or similar
• Develop user interfaces using modern frameworks like React
• Work with containerized applications and tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
• Apply debugging techniques and testing practices to ensure quality and reliability
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment
• Learn and explore emerging technologies, including AI/LLM-based components and cloud-native tools

Requirements:
• High School Diploma/GED
• Experience working with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++)
• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including version control and basic testing concepts
• Familiarity with cloud environments, APIs, or container technologies like Docker or Kubernetes
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively in a team setting
• IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Exposure to back-end or front-end frameworks (e.g., React, FastAPI, Flask, Spring Boot)
• Understanding of cloud-native technologies, CI/CD processes, or DevOps practices
• Familiarity with NoSQL or relational databases
• Interest or academic experience in AI/ML, including LLM-based systems or agent workflows
• Experience building reusable components, responsive UIs, or scalable services
